title: Uruguayan-Style Smoked Turkey Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with smoky Uruguayan sausage, tender turkey, and a blend of aromatic spices.
instructions: 1. In a large Dutch oven, brown the sliced Uruguayan smoked sausage over medium-high heat.
2. Remove the cooked sausage from the pot and set aside.
3. Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
4. Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
5. Add the turkey thighs to the pot and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
6. Add the canned diced tomatoes, stew, red wine, chili powder, salt, and black pepper to the pot.
7. Stir to combine and bring the mixture to a simmer.
8. Return the cooked sausage to the pot and continue to simmer for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the turkey is cooked through.
9. Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or thyme if desired.
